shots.img: Extreme close-up at floor level showing ONLY the old man's feet and ankles (nothing above the knees is visible): worn blue-and-white plastic flip-flop slippers on thin tanned feet stepping onto the shiny polished white marble floor, warm gold light reflections on the marble, the luxury lobby far behind is heavily blurred bokeh.

vo.text: [annoyed] 欸欸欸——阿伯！這裡不能發傳單喔！

line.text: [calm] 我不是發傳單的。我來看房子。

shots.prompt: The old man speaks calmly and plainly, slight head movement.

line.text: [sarcastic] 看房子？頂樓那戶，三千八百萬欸。阿伯……你看看就好。
